<section class="section s-light" aria-labelledby="how-title"><div class="wrap"><div class="head"><span class="eyebrow">Camera on every job</span><h2 id="how-title">What we do differently</h2><p class="lead">None of these is a slogan. Each one changes what a job costs or what you end up with.</p></div><div class="steps2"><div class="st2"><h3>Camera before quote</h3><p>Nobody can tell what is in a drain from the fixture, so we stopped guessing. A camera goes down the line before a repair is quoted, and you watch the same screen we do. It is slower at the start and considerably cheaper by the end.</p></div><div class="st2"><h3>The price before the work</h3><p>You are told what a job costs before it begins, and nothing proceeds until you agree to it. That applies at two in the morning exactly as it does at two in the afternoon.</p></div><div class="st2"><h3>The cheaper option first</h3><p>Relining gets assessed before replacement because it avoids digging. Clearing gets assessed before relining because sometimes a line is simply dirty. Starting at the expensive end is easy and we do not do it.</p></div><div class="st2"><h3>Telling you when you do not need us</h3><p>If the camera shows a sound pipe, that is the finding. If a scheduled clean would not pay for itself on your property, we say so. Work nobody needed is how a trade loses the next five jobs.</p></div></div></div></section>
<section class="section s-white" aria-labelledby="does-title"><div class="wrap"><div class="head"><span class="eyebrow">Clearing, diagnosis and repair</span><h2 id="does-title">What the business actually does</h2></div><div class="reveal"><div class="rv"><span class="rv-ic"><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-water"></use></svg></span><h3>Blocked drains, every kind</h3><p>Kitchen, bathroom, laundry, toilet, sewer and stormwater. Clearing a blockage is the largest part of what we do and the reason most people call.</p></div><div class="rv"><span class="rv-ic"><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-video"></use></svg></span><h3>Finding out why it blocked</h3><p>Drain camera work, so the cause is identified rather than guessed. This is what separates a drain that stays clear from one that blocks again in autumn.</p></div><div class="rv"><span class="rv-ic"><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-rotate"></use></svg></span><h3>Repairing the pipe itself</h3><p>Trenchless relining where a pipe is cracked or roots are getting in, and replacement where a line has collapsed and a liner cannot restore it.</p></div><div class="rv"><span class="rv-ic"><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-building"></use></svg></span><h3>Commercial and strata drainage</h3><p>Kitchens, unit blocks, offices and industrial sites, on scheduled programmes and emergency call-outs, with records a committee or a manager can use.</p></div></div></div></section>
<section class="section s-light" aria-labelledby="claims-title"><div class="wrap"><div class="callout"><span class="co-ic"><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-shield"></use></svg></span><div><h2 id="claims-title">What we will not claim</h2><p>No customer counts and no awards. Not because either could never be true, but because we have not put anything on this site that we could not back up if you asked us to.</p><p>What is here instead is the licence number, the ABN, the insurance position, how a job actually runs and what decides the price. If a figure matters to you and it is not on this page, ring and ask.</p></div></div></div></section>
<section class="section s-white" aria-labelledby="area-title"><div class="wrap"><div class="head"><span class="eyebrow">19 coverage areas</span><h2 id="area-title">Where we work</h2><p class="lead">Greater Sydney, from the CBD out through the Inner West, the Eastern Suburbs, the North Shore and Northern Beaches, Western Sydney, the Hills District, the Sutherland Shire and the South West.</p></div><div class="hh-acts" style="margin-top:0"><a class="btn btn-navy btn-lg" href="/area-we-serve/"><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-map-loc"></use></svg> See the areas we serve</a></div></div></section>
<section class="section s-light" aria-labelledby="faq-title"><div class="wrap"><div class="head center"><span class="eyebrow">Quick answers</span><h2 id="faq-title">Questions people ask first</h2></div><div class="faqs"><details class="faq"><summary><span class="fq-mark"><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-chev-down"></use></svg></span>Are you licensed and insured?</summary><div class="fq-body"><p>Yes. We hold NSW plumbing licence 306733C and we are fully insured for the work we carry out. data.name: About Sydney Blocked Drain Service
data.description: A licensed Sydney drainage specialist. Licence, insurance and registration details, and how the work is actually carried out.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We hold NSW plumbing licence 306733C and we are fully insured for the work we carry out. Certificates are available on request, and the licence number is on every page of this site rather than buried on one.

mainEntity.name: How long have you been doing this?

acceptedAnswer.text: We have been working on Sydney drains for 15+ years. What we can point to is the licence, the insurance and the ABN above, all of which are checkable, and the way the work is actually done, which is described on this page.

Any guarantee we offered would be set out in writing with the quote, and it would say exactly what it covers. We do not make a general guarantee claim on this page, because an unqualified promise on a website is worth nothing to you when something goes wrong.

mainEntity.name: How quickly can you get here?

acceptedAnswer.text: We aim to reach most Sydney jobs within 60 minutes. Sydney traffic and what is already running affect that on the day, so treat it as what we aim for rather than a promise. What we can say is that drain calls are taken 24 hours, including nights, weekends and public holidays, and that an overflow into a property is treated as an emergency.

mainEntity.name: Do you do general plumbing as well as drains?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drains and drainage are the specialisation, and it is what this site is about. If you need drainage work, from a blocked kitchen sink through to relining a failed sewer line, that is squarely what we do. For anything outside drainage, ring and ask rather than assuming either way.
